quant_tensor_sym: quantize a PyTorch tensor using symmetric RTN quantization with configurable bits and group size
quant_tensor_asym: quantize a PyTorch tensor using asymmetric RTN quantization with zero-point and configurable bits
quant_tensor_opt_rtn_sym: quantize a tensor using optimized symmetric RTN with importance matrix weighted scale search
quant_tensor_sym_gptq: quantize a tensor using GPTQ-style symmetric quantization with centered zero-point for full unsigned range
search_scales: search for optimal quantization scales by iteratively minimizing MSE loss across a grid of candidates
